tiles.name: TILE MANAGER
tiles.desc: JSON-driven static homepage generator. Edit tiles in the admin panel, export, and deploy to Cloudflare Pages in one build step.

tiles.name: TILE ADMIN
tiles.desc: Drag-and-drop tile editor with import/export. Manage sections, reorder tiles, and push updates without touching JSON directly.

tiles.name: BLANK SLATE
tiles.desc: Fork this repo, drop your tiles.json and site.json into site/, connect Cloudflare Pages, and you have a live homepage in under five minutes.

tiles.name: SNIPPET VAULT
tiles.desc: A local-first command-line snippet manager. Tag, search, and pipe code snippets with full syntax highlighting in the terminal.

tiles.name: UPTIME BEACON
tiles.desc: Lightweight uptime monitor with public status pages, email alerts, and a 90-day response time graph. Self-host or deploy to Workers.

tiles.name: FORM RELAY
tiles.desc: A zero-dependency HTML form backend. Point your form action at the endpoint and get submissions delivered to email or webhook — no server required.

tiles.name: RATE GATE
tiles.desc: Cloudflare Worker middleware that adds per-IP rate limiting, JWT verification, and structured request logging to any existing API.

tiles.name: NOTED
tiles.desc: Semantic search across a folder of markdown notes using local embeddings. No cloud, no account, no data leaving your machine.

tiles.name: HEADER AUDIT
tiles.desc: Paste a URL and get a full security header report with grades, recommended fixes, and a copy-pasteable Cloudflare Worker to patch gaps.

tiles.name: GITHUB
tiles.desc: The home of open source. Host repositories, review pull requests, run Actions CI, and ship software with the world's largest developer community.

tiles.name: CLAUDE
tiles.desc: Anthropic's AI assistant. Write code, analyze documents, think through hard problems, and build AI-powered applications via the API.

tiles.name: CLOUDFLARE
tiles.desc: Faster, safer internet. DNS, CDN, Pages, Workers, R2 storage, and a global edge network. Where this site is probably deployed.
